static_traits.name: Ma Liang
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with brothers tense due to Avoids cooking and gatherings; reduced social participation, feeling uncomfortable talking about own insufficiencies
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never had similar psychological problems before; never received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, Neutral attitude, able to Reflect and cooperate, cautious but open about change

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my barbecue skills are terrible, no one likes the food I make, although I really like barbecuing.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of cooking incapability are starting to affect my overall enjoyment of activities and social interaction.
growth_experiences: After buying the first house, hosting a barbecue for brothers and friends at the new home, during which someone commented the food was 'not as good as others', these evaluations gradually Reinforced Self-doubt and insufficiency about cooking ability, then began avoiding cooking and hosting gatherings.
Past cooking skills Being criticized and frequent comparison with others, gradually internalized into a negative evaluation of one's own cooking ability ('not as good as others').

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / incapable (in cooking)
My worth depends on others' recognition of my food

special_situations.event: When hosting a barbecue gathering for brothers and friends at the new home, someone commented my food was not as good as others'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my food is not as good as others', others will not like me, I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively seeks affirmation from others, trying to prove himself through others' evaluations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think what I make tastes awful; I am no good

special_situations.event: Whenever Thinking about having to cook or hosting events at home
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I mess up again, I will be laughed at and disappoint everyone
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids cooking and gatherings to reduce the risk of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely mess up; everyone will hate me

special_situations.event: When comparing with people better at grilling
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching or exceeding others' level counts as qualified; otherwise it is total failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces cooking by hand or only makes the simplest dishes to avoid exposing failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them, nothing I do is good enough

special_situations.event: When hosting family and friends as the new homeowner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As the host, I should satisfy everyone, otherwise I am an unqualified host
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly observing others' reactions, repeatedly verifying others' evaluations to Gain recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If they do not like it, I am a terrible host

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be liked and recognized, gaining others' affirmation as host / Chef
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated, humiliated, judged as incapable and Being rejected
defense_goal: Avoiding criticism and shame through Avoids cooking and gatherings
Maintaining self-esteem with others' recognition, easing not-good-enough feelings
Reducing self-disclosure to maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough Chef / possibly failing host
A person who needs to please others
object_relations.object_representation: Others who hold the standards of evaluation and are easily disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks whether willing to talk about own insufficiencies and feelings with brothers
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing showing vulnerability will be looked down on or Being rejected (transference: seeing others as harsh judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use rule-based expressions (such as 'I should not appear weak'), downplaying emotional experience, instead emphasizing 'should carry it alone', restrained tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes doing behavioral experiments or new attempts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: These methods may be useless for me, if they fail it will prove I am no good
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Raising doubts in a gentle but reserved tone, use expressions like 'I am not sure this suits me / will change anything', weakening implementation commitments.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling or discussing others' reactions and feedback to food
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others all dislike my food (Projecting Self-denial as others' evaluation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use assertive sentences like 'they must think......', ignoring contrary evidence; certain tone but with Self-denial.

manifestations: Unwilling to discuss own insufficiencies and vulnerability with brothers
Avoids hosting or joining cooking and gatherings, reducing genuine contact with others
outcomes: Relationship tension with brothers, Reduced socializing

manifestations: Frustrated with the barbecue interest she once liked; the enjoyment of the activity declines
outcomes: Overall Decreased motivation, weakened life satisfaction

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Treats 'the host should satisfy everyone' as a hard standard to demand of oneself
Repressing self-expression due to the inner rule of 'should not appear weak'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Concluding 'everyone dislikes what I make' without verification
Uses 'their thoughts' to explain his own inferiority and avoidance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Repeatedly blaming oneself 'I am not as good as others', carefully avoiding exposing insufficiencies in social settings
Suppressing genuine expression for fear of being looked down on

positive_force: Has passion for barbecue and is willing to try in small steps (such as first doing simple practice for oneself)
Lives with his brother; has certain family support resources
Work functioning is basically stable; life has some structure and rhythm
Able to notice and express own negative thoughts and feelings, having some Reflection ability
negative_force: Over-relying on external recognition, prone to negating positive feedback
Cognitive biases are marked, such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and overgeneralization
Comparison with others leading to low self-esteem and Withdrawal
Reducing Anxiety through Avoids cooking and socializing, instead Reinforcement the sense of incapability
Unwilling to express vulnerability, worrying about being looked down on, worsening Relationship estrangement

antecedent: Thinking about cooking or entertaining others
Recalls others' negative comments about one's own food
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being negated and shame, catastrophically predicting failure outcomes
target_behavior.function: Escaping being judged and negative emotions, short-term Anxiety relief
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension with brothers, Reduced socializing, Decreased enjoyment of life, eating habits affected

antecedent: After cooking or talking about cooking
When feeling uneasy about one's own cooking skills
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth tied to others' evaluations, lacking an inner sense of approval
target_behavior.function: Gaining comfort, short-term relief of uncertainty and unease
target_behavior.consequence: Positive feedback negated or feeling insincere, further Reinforcement incapability and Self-doubt
